suggested_snapshot_fields_to_add.why: Convert free-text intent into exact machine-readable requirements such as required cells, allowed end cells, retreat flag, and preferred action type.
Makes landing-cell targeting explicit for fast movers so attacks can be aimed at post-move hexes instead of current hexes.
Precompute full resolved attack coverage union so exact-hit checks do not require the model to merge target_cell, ray_cells, line_cells, affected_cells, and intercept_cells itself.
Provides a single engine-defined cell for echo_cell validation across move, attack, and wait options.
